candidate_dispositions.explanation: Ambulance transport to a hospital is documented, but the note does not establish inpatient admission; the label also places the inability to walk or run under an admission event.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: She was taken to the hospital (Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kyoto Interdisciplinary Institute Hospital of Community Medicine, Kyoto, Japan) by ambulance.

candidate_dispositions.explanation: The symptom entry names the earlier thigh pain, so its location should remain the anterior left thigh. The left hip is the location of a later, distinct pain episode.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: She developed pain in the anterior part of the left thigh while training nine days before a prefectural track meet

candidate_dispositions.explanation: These details describe the later severe hip pain and resulting inability to walk or run, not the earlier thigh pain represented by this symptom entry.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: Seven days later, she suddenly developed severe pain in the left hip while running, and she was thereafter unable to walk or run.

candidate_dispositions.explanation: The diagnosis test result omits material details describing the fracture displacement and lack of continuity between fragments.
candidate_dispositions.source_quote: The Devas classification of the fracture was a displaced type []. The femoral head was adducted, and the shaft had been displaced upward by 2.5 cm. There was no continuity between the proximal and distal fragments.

added_findings.source_quote: Her coaches had placed her on a strict diet to keep her weight low since she was 12 years old. In particular, she had never eaten dinner for two weeks before any track meets.
added_findings.explanation: The label omits sustained restrictive eating and the pre-meet dinner restriction, material physiological context alongside the documented lack of menarche.

added_findings.source_quote: She had run about 210 km a week during her junior high school years and 140 km a week during her high school years on a tartan track.
added_findings.explanation: The label omits the unusually high weekly running volume, relevant physiological and training context for the presentation.

initial.summary: The four candidate findings are supported. The label also omits material dietary restriction and high-volume running history.
